description: This file is a shell script for testing the functionality of a Git tool related to finding and verifying pack files within a Git repository. It uses functions from an external test library to set up a repository, perform commits, pack objects, and check pack file existence and contents.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
